description: Ciclorruta. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Desarrollo Urbano - IDU. Calzada destinada de manera permanente a la circulación de bicicletas, ubicada en el andén, el separador o segregada de la calzada vehicular o en otros lugares autorizados, debidamente señalizada y delimitada. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto de Desarrollo Urbano - IDU. Its tags are Transporte, cicloruta. It offers 10 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-08-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
